quarantine_history.original_isolation_reason: GPU2 was quaranined during TRUE_T10 launch preparation. The condition spec V2 includes gpu_denylist=[2] citing prior instability with OpenVLA-7B model loading on this GPU causing InternalError (CUDA/PTX miscompilation).
quarantine_history.quarantine_trigger: 22 InternalError failures during CLEAN1500 collection on GPU2, with symptoms pointing to ptxas 10.1.243 miscompilation of XLA code. The ptxas version on the server is older than the required 11.1, causing intermittent incorrect results or invalid-address errors on GPU2's SM configuration.
quarantine_history.symptoms_summary: 22 InternalError occurrences — XLA JIT compilation falling back from PTX to driver compilation. ptxas 10.1.243 is known to miscompile for A800 SM_80 architecture in edge cases. GPU2 may have a specific microarchitectural variant or thermal profile that triggers the miscompilation more frequently than other GPUs.
quarantine_history.error_signature: E external/local_xla/xla/stream_executor/gpu/asm_compiler.cc:115] *** WARNING *** You are using ptxas 10.1.243, which is older than 11.1. ptxas before 11.1 is known to miscompile XLA code, leading to incorrect results or invalid-address errors.
quarantine_history.impact: CLEAN1500 jobs on GPU2 would fail non-deterministically with InternalError, causing queue stalls and requiring manual retry. Jobs were redistributed to GPUs 3,4,5,6,7.

internal_error_summary.note: All other GPUs (0,1,3,4,5,6,7) also show the same ptxas warnings but do NOT produce InternalError. GPU2 may have a specific hardware or thermal characteristic that triggers the edge case.

remediation_actions_taken.primary_action: GPU2 quarantined — removed from TRUE_T10 launch per gpu_denylist=[2] in condition spec
remediation_actions_taken.secondary_action: GPU2 CLEAN1500 jobs redistributed to GPUs 3,4,5,6,7
remediation_actions_taken.no_driver_update: ptxas update would require CUDA toolkit upgrade, which risks breaking the conda environment's prebuilt XLA/TF wheels

current_gpu2_state.our_workloads: NONE — GPU2 has no TRUE_T10 or CLEAN1500 processes
